facts.about: HDFC Bank Limited (also known as HDFC) is an Indian banking and financial services company headquartered in Mumbai. It is India's largest private sector bank by assets and the world's tenth-largest bank by market capitalization as of May 2024. As of April 2024, HDFC Bank has a market capitalization of $145 billion, making it the third-largest company on the Indian stock exchanges.

business.summary: HDFC Bank Limited is an Indian banking company providing commercial banking services, treasury operations, retail banking, wholesale banking, and insurance services, earning revenue through interest, fees, investments, and financial intermediation.

scorecard.promised: Grow at 18% to 21% depending on economic developments.
scorecard.delivered: Revenue grew 9.4% year-on-year in the latest quarter.
scorecard.evidence: Revenue growth of 9.4% in Sep 2026 is significantly below the 18-21% target range.

scorecard.promised: Operate between 110 and 120, targeting a midpoint of 115.
scorecard.delivered: Management maintains the 115 target despite retail deposit and CD ratio pressures.
scorecard.evidence: Horizon is 'next few years'; current analyst pushback highlights ongoing pressure on LCR and CD ratios.

scorecard.promised: Achieve handsome and significant market share milestones by September.
scorecard.delivered: Revenue growth accelerated to 9.4% in Sep 2026 from 3.7% in Jun 2026.
scorecard.evidence: While revenue growth improved in the target quarter, it remains well below the 3-year trend of 27%.

narrative.scoreline: Management has successfully defended asset quality and absolute profit levels, but is struggling to meet ambitious growth and margin recovery targets post-merger.

narrativeVsNumbers.claim: Asset quality remains pristine with declining GNPA.
Net interest margins are positioned for a reversal upward.
narrativeVsNumbers.reality: Financing margins remained negative at -6% in Sep 2026, though improved from -17% in Jun 2026.

narrativeVsNumbers.claim: Deposit growth is faster than credit and system growth.
narrativeVsNumbers.reality: Revenue growth of 0.5% to 9.4% in recent quarters is well below the 27% three-year trend.

bull: Asset quality is superior with GNPA at 1.11%, down 13 basis points year-on-year.
Strong cash generation with CFO of ₹113,506 cr in FY26 and high PAT conversion.
Net profit reached a quarterly record of ₹21,537 cr in September 2026.
bear: Financing margins remain deeply negative at -12% for FY26 compared to +18% in FY23.
Revenue growth of 9% is significantly lagging the historical three-year average of 27%.
Business banking growth of 9.4% is missing the management target of 18-21%.
watch: Recovery of financing margins from current -6% toward positive historical norms.
Stabilization of LCR within the promised 110-120 range.
Impact of contingent liabilities and derivative modifications with HDFC Life.

claims.claim: GNPA is at 1.11%, which is 13 basis points lower than year-on-year.
claims.quote: Our asset quality remains pristine, with GNPA at 1.11%, 13 basis points lower than year-on-year.

claims.claim: Net interest margins are positioned for a reversal as we enter the upward rate cycle.
claims.quote: net interest margins... is also positioned for a reversal as we enter the upward rate cycle.

claims.claim: Credit costs remain low at 44 basis points.
claims.quote: Credit costs remain low at 44 basis points, the risk weights to total assets at 69%.

claims.claim: Cost of funds is the biggest opportunity on the margin with potential for 40, 50 basis points change.
claims.quote: one, the cost of funds is the biggest opportunity on the margin where compared to our historical norms as well as compared to what we have seen in the industry as such, there can be 40, 50 basis points change, but it is not going to change in a hurry.

claims.claim: Branch addition early vintages perform to legacy vintages, with average per branch metrics at INR 330 crores.
claims.quote: So, the branch addition at an aggregate level, the early vintages are performing to the legacy branch vintages and the legacy branch vintages are also progressing towards what a 10-plus years and a 15-years plus years will do

claims.claim: Household deposit growth is low; our strategy is about increasing units and unit economics rather than relying on high household deposit growth.
claims.quote: Our approach is to increase the units to get that benefit. Sashi, you can add.

claims.claim: Reserving process is adequate and we do not expect anything material in terms of credit cost impact.
claims.quote: Considering where we are today and looking 12 months down the line, we do believe that our reserving process and the reserving methodology is quite adequate.

claims.claim: Deposit growth rate at 14.4% continues to grow faster than credit growth and is better than system growth.
claims.quote: Deposit growth rate at 14.4% continues to grow faster than the credit growth, which is what we've always been doing. The growth rate is better than the system growth rate yet again.

claims.claim: Asset quality is healthy at 1.15% gross NPAs and the bank has created a large provisioning buffer of 125 bps.
claims.quote: Our asset quality is extremely healthy at 1.15% gross NPAs. This has been tested across 3 decades of business cycles. The bank has created a large provisioning buffer of almost 125 basis points to absorb any shocks in the future

claims.claim: Cost-to-income declined from 40.5% to 39.5% on a core basis, reflecting cost efficiencies.
claims.quote: Despite the drop in NIMs, the return on assets continue to be stable at 1.9% due to cost efficiencies with cost-to-income declining from 40.5% to 39.5% on a core basis

risks.text: Gross NPA as at 31 March 2026 is Rs. 34,061.19 crore with NPA provision of Rs. 22,891.65 crore.
Contingent liability includes claims against the Bank not acknowledged as debts relating to taxation.
Contingent liabilities include liability on account of forward exchange and derivative contracts.
Material related party transactions and derivative modifications proposed with subsidiary HDFC Life.
